presets.title: World Presets
presets.balanceDesc: All 15+ simulation mechanics active in living harmony: balanced border skirmishes, mild predation, seasonal plagues, bridges, and thriving multi-generational clans.
presets.sustainableDesc: Bountiful agriculture (360 food), rich granaries, seasonal banquets, glowing temples, and gentle winters for long flourishing dynasties.
presets.theocracyDesc: Spiritual civilization: devoted prayer to the 8 Sacred 2D Avatars, glowing Temples of the Sphere, divine miracles, and holy synods.
presets.warlordsDesc: High martial expansion: tactical clan warfare, defensive coalitions, granary plundering, territorial takeovers, and contested thrones.
presets.chaosDesc: Brutal stress test: high predator packs, lethal wars, frequent plagues, wildfires, earthquakes, and rapid seasonal turnover.
presets.extinctionDesc: Extreme famine (120 food), freezing winter (0.3x), rampant disease, exposure drain, and desperate cannibalism.
presets.boomDesc: Massive urban growth: rapid reproduction, food abundance (500), giant granaries, bridges, and bustling settlements.

wiki.title: 📖 Flatland Wiki
wiki.aboutDesc: Flatland is an autonomous 2D artificial life and ecosystem simulation developed from the foundational ideas of Edwin A. Abbott's 1884 classic Flatland: A Romance of Many Dimensions. Rather than mimicking the novella literally, it takes Flatland's core geometric premises to build a living, autonomous evolutionary ecosystem that organically evolves and changes over time.
wiki.sphereDesc: The Sphere (God Model): The Sphere (God) sets universal laws of nature from Spaceland, never intervening in individual lives. Everything is 100% emergent.
wiki.evolutionDesc: Autonomous Evolution: Heritable personality archetypes (brave, altruistic, builder, etc.), tools (spears, baskets, poultices, crowns), 4 mastery skills (Farming 🌾, Combat ⚔️, Foraging 🦴, Healing 🌿), dynamic titles, and oral lore taught in houses.
wiki.lifeStagesDesc: Life Stages & Metabolism: Infant low burn (0.45×), combat stamina drain, field food reserves, and natural lifespans.
wiki.settlementsDesc: Settlements & Politics: Walled houses, multi-house clan territories, settlement food larders, mutual coalitions, and schisms.
wiki.spherePanelDesc: The Sphere Panel (⚖ The Sphere) — Adjust carrying capacity, food growth, metabolism, disease, and apply presets.
wiki.inspectorDesc: Creature Inspector — Tap any creature to view its live vitals, personality, tools, skill mastery, and family lineage.
wiki.controlsDesc: Controls: Space pause, S step, R reset seed, F fit camera, +/- zoom, drag to pan.
wiki.lensesIntro: Flatland dynamically visualizes each creature's living genome, morphological mutations, and generational lineage across millennia (Gen 0 → 2000+):
wiki.lensEpochsDesc: Evolutionary palette transitions from Primordial Cyan (Gen 0) through Dynastic Jade, Imperial Violet, Sovereign Magenta, and Solar Gold to Transcendent Celestial Starlight (Gen 2000+).
wiki.lensCoronasDesc: Lineages past Gen 50 earn radiant starburst coronas scaling up to 24 coronal rays with orbiting diamond starlight flares at Gen 2000+.
wiki.lensMutantsDesc: Morphological irregularity shifts body hues toward radiant violet and crimson, with radical mutants emitting bioluminescent chaotic auras.
wiki.lensTraitsDesc: Razor blades glint on sharpest apex vertices (Dmult), inertia armor thickens kinetic shells (Izz), and crystalline core patinas solidify ancient ancestry.
wiki.docLanding: Official Landing Page — Project overview & media showcase
wiki.docWiki: Backend Living Wiki (/wiki) — Full documentation with presets & curl playground
wiki.docGuide: Living Guide (/guide) — Codebase architecture and system maps
wiki.bookTitle: 📚 Flatland: Abbott's Novella vs. The Simulation
wiki.bookDesc: A comparative study between Edwin A. Abbott’s 1884 satirical classic Flatland: A Romance of Many Dimensions and our autonomous artificial life simulation.
wiki.hierarchyBook: "Configuration makes the man." Social rank is governed strictly by side count and angular regularity.
wiki.hierarchySim: Entities inherit exact geometric castes based on vertex count (N-gons) and regularity.
wiki.womenBook: Straight lines (zero angular width). Required to maintain a continuous peace-cry to prevent accidental stabbing.
wiki.womenSim: Rendered as 1D segments (shape: 'line'). Highly agile with distinct domestic shelter dynamics.
wiki.soldiersBook: Isosceles triangles with sharp vertex angles (volatile and militaristic).
wiki.soldiersSim: Soldiers: High combat damage, defensive patrolling, equipped with spears.
wiki.artisansBook: Equilateral triangles (3 equal sides) — steady tradespeople.
wiki.artisansSim: Artisans (3–4 sides): Farmers, foragers, and builders managing houses and larders.
wiki.gentlemenBook: Squares (4 sides), Pentagons (5 sides), Hexagons (6 sides), and high polygons.
wiki.gentlemenSim: Gentlemen (4), Professionals (5), Nobles (6–8): Administrative prestige and leadership.
wiki.priestsBook: Polygons with so many sides that vertices appear as smooth circles. Rule society and religion.
wiki.priestsSim: Priests (≥ 24 sides): Soothing auras, healing injured/infected clanmates, disease immunity.
wiki.bookSection2Desc: In Abbott's world, the Law of Upward Development guarantees that sons of regular polygons gain +1 side over their fathers (Square → Pentagon → Hexagon), ascending toward circular priesthood over generations. In our simulation, offspring inherit side counts with probabilistic side promotions (sides += 1) and lineage tracking via the Family Tree.
wiki.bookSection3Desc: In Flatland, 2D beings look like flat edges. In the foggy South, they rely on Sight Recognition (how quickly vertices fade into fog). In our simulation, the Dynamic Weather Engine simulates Clear, Fog, Rain, and Storms, modulating creature sight_radius and forcing reliance on auditory alarms (signals).
wiki.bookSection4: 4. The Higher Dimension: The User as "The Sphere"
wiki.bookSection4Desc: In the novel, A Square is visited by A Sphere from 3D Spaceland, who gazes down into closed rooms, inspects interiors, and manipulates 2D physics. In our app, you are the Sphere (God): peering down from the Z-axis, inspecting creature minds and lineage, and tuning the fundamental Laws of Nature via The Sphere Panel.

godHints.poison_rate: Probability a new wild sprout is poisonous (-30 HP damage on ingestion).
godHints.beast_ratio: wild herbivores as fraction of creature density — grazers that feed predators
godHints.diet_strictness: 0 omnivore, 1 strict — herbivore ignores meat, predator ignores plants
godHints.territory_radius: Radius of clan territorial influence around settlement houses (16).
godHints.trespass_decay: Diplomatic relation points lost per tick when a rival clan enters marked territory (0.15).
godHints.house_decay_ticks: Ticks before an abandoned, roofless house crumbles into ruins (10000).
godHints.energy_decay_per_tick: Baseline metabolic burn rate per tick without food (0.025).
godHints.energy_from_food: Base energy yield from harvesting a mature plant (berry 48, grass 32, mushroom 24, poison 8).
godHints.perceive_radius: Base perception sight radius (16) — scaled by caste (Woman 0.8×, Priest 1.35×), night (0.6×), and fog (0.6×).
godHints.food_giveup_ticks: a meal blocked by rock/wall is abandoned this many ticks — the hungry give up and seek food elsewhere (0 = never give up)
godHints.lifespan_mult: Multiplier scaling all caste lifespans (Woman: 4,800 ticks → Priest: 9,000 ticks).
godHints.door_clearance: Width multiplier for house doorways relative to the largest creature size (1.5).
godHints.house_min_size: applies to houses built after the next reset (6)
godHints.house_max_size: applies to houses built after the next reset (10)
godHints.adult_age: Ticks required for an infant/juvenile to mature into a sexually fertile adult (220).
godHints.birth_rate: Base reproduction probability per eligible adult mating pair per tick (0.28).
godHints.sex_ratio: Probability a newborn child is a son (ascending polygon) vs daughter (agile line) (0.50).
godHints.mutation_rate: Probability a newborn son deviates ±1 side from classical caste inheritance (0.05).
godHints.mutation_heritability: Fraction of parental irregularity inherited by child (0.35; lower prevents rapid irregularity spread).
godHints.euthanasia_threshold: Irregularity threshold; deformed infants exceeding this are consumed at adulthood (0.70).
godHints.carrying_capacity: Population density threshold above which fertility gradually fades (-1 = auto).
godHints.max_population: Hard global population cap preventing any new births until density declines (-1 = auto).
godHints.house_capacity: Bed capacity inside a settlement hall (12); excess members sleep outdoors.
godHints.exposure_drain: Health and energy drain per tick when outdoors during harsh weather (0.025).
godHints.rest_recovery_mult: Health regeneration multiplier when sleeping indoors under a roof (2.0).
godHints.age_length: Duration in ticks per world historical epoch (50000).
godHints.culture_spread_rate: Rate at which allied clans sharing borders adopt common cultural traits and beliefs (0.0005).
godHints.trait_mutation_rate: chance mutation adds heritable trait greedy/peaceful/paranoid/bold (0.02) — bold war, paranoid flee, greedy food
godHints.fire_rate: Probability per tick that a mature plant ignites during dry spells or lightning strikes (0.00008).
godHints.river_count: Number of procedural river channels carved across the terrain at world generation (2).
godHints.signal_speed: news wavefront speed in units/tick (8) — distant ears hear the alarm later; wind carries sound faster downwind; 0 = instant
godHints.earthquake_rate: Frequency of seismic quakes that crack buildings and shake terrain (0.00008).
godHints.lightning_strike_rate: Frequency of deadly electrical arc strikes during thunder storms (0.0015).
godHints.anomaly_count: Number of mysterious spatial anomaly zones altering local physics (3).
godHints.fire_spread_rate: spread to neighboring plants within 6 (0.08) — kills creatures/plants, ash fertilizes
godHints.disaster_rate: Stochastic probability of catastrophic environmental disasters (0.0003).
godHints.signal_radius: heard within this range (12) — clan-mates respond strongly, strangers weakly
godHints.food_call_rate: well-fed finds food → calls with this chance/tick (0.08)

godHints.coalition_min_size: smallest viable coalition; smaller blocs dissolve (2)
godHints.larder_capacity: Energy capacity of settlement communal food stores where surplus is shared (300).
godHints.aid_rate: chance/tick a full-bellied ally tops up a starving ally's larder (0.05)
godHints.boundary: World border topology: wrap (seamless toroidal loop) vs clamp (solid collision walls).
godHints.energy_max: Maximum metabolic energy capacity an organism can store (10–500).
godHints.plant_variants_enabled: Master switch enabling botanical biodiversity across 6 distinct functional plant species.
godHints.food_decay_enabled: Enables mature plants to naturally wither over time and fertilize the living soil.
godHints.food_lifespan_ticks: Ticks a mature plant lives before naturally withering into the living soil grid (8000).
godHints.agriculture_enabled: Enables seed gathering, cultivated farm plots (2× growth, 2.5× yield), irrigation furrows, and tending.
godHints.granaries_enabled: Enables communal settlement granaries to stockpile grain and berries against winter.
godHints.granary_capacity: Units of food a settlement granary can store (400) — feasts fire at ≥80% capacity.
godHints.eat_radius: Physical contact distance required to consume a plant, corpse, or prey item (1.4).
godHints.hungry_ratio: Energy threshold (≤35%) feeding normalized energy into neural network input slot 0 to trigger foraging.
godHints.starving_ratio: Severe energy threshold (≤15%) triggering desperation sprint and pulsing survival distress.
godHints.steer_turn: Maximum heading angular turn agility per tick, scaled by creature moment of inertia Izz.
godHints.birth_enabled: Master switch enabling reproduction, mating, and generational ascendance.
godHints.max_sides: Upper limit on regular polygon vertex ascendance (up to Priest / Circle status) (24).
godHints.mutation_sigma: Gaussian mutation standard deviation (σ) applied to genome weights during crossover (0.08).
godHints.crossover_rate: Probability of uniform 50/50 parental genome blending during sexual reproduction (0.50).
godHints.morphology_annealing_enabled: Master switch for geometric physics — polar (r,φ) annealing, SAT polygon collision, and trait baking.
godHints.annealing_start_generation: Generation where polar morphology starts decaying from Abbott templates (15; higher delays speciation).
godHints.annealing_decay_generations: Generations over which polar morphology decays to free evolution (250; higher slows speciation).
godHints.morph_lambda_override: Manual λ override: -1.0 auto annealing, 0.0 to 1.0 pinned weight (1.0 = strict classical).
godHints.vertex_mutation_std: Radial jitter standard deviation for polar genomes (0.025; lower creates subtle shape variations).
godHints.angle_mutation_std: Angular jitter standard deviation for polar vertices (0.012; lower creates subtle angle variations).
godHints.topological_mutation_rate: Topological mutation rate: probability to add/remove vertices (0.008; lower slows topological change).
godHints.safeguard_enabled: Master switch for homeostatic extinction relief loops and Sphere Genesis miracles.
godHints.safeguard_critical_pop: Population floor Kcrit (<=12) triggering emergency Tier 3 Genesis miracles from The Sphere.
godHints.safeguard_relief_ratio: Carrying capacity ratio Ksafe = carrying * ratio (0.30) below which Tier 1/2 relief scales activate.
godHints.safeguard_genesis_batch: Number of pristine regular polygon beings created per Tier 3 Genesis miracle (6).
godHints.safeguard_morph_mercy: Suspends euthanasia of irregular infants during low-population relief states (eta > 0.30).
godHints.soft_cap_enabled: Master switch for non-linear density-dependent homeostatic damping above carrying capacity.
godHints.damping_steepness: Divisor coefficient damping birth rate as population overshoots carrying capacity (1/(1+d*xi^2)).
godHints.crowding_stress_mult: Multiplier scaling metabolic energy decay under overpopulation density stress (1+c*xi).
godHints.resource_strain_mult: Multiplier scaling plant growth & spread slowdown under overpopulation strain (1/(1+r*xi)).
godHints.disease_enabled: Master switch for infectious pathogen outbreaks and contagion transmission.
godHints.disease_outbreak_rate: Spontaneous plague outbreak probability per tick during crowded conditions (0.00006).
godHints.disease_rate: Contagion transmission probability per tick within contact range (0.035).
godHints.disease_energy_drain: Metabolic energy drained per tick from actively infected creatures (0.05).
godHints.disease_lethality: Direct health (HP) damage dealt per tick to actively diseased creatures (0.18).
godHints.weather_enabled: Master switch for dynamic meteorological cycles (sun, rain, fog, storms).
godHints.sleep_enabled: Enables diurnal sleep cycles, house resting, and oral lore transfer after dark.
godHints.day_length: Total duration in ticks of a single diurnal day/night cycle (1200).
godHints.season_length: Duration in ticks of each season (Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter) (12000).
godHints.night_sight_mult: Perception radius multiplier during night ticks for non-nocturnal castes (0.60).
godHints.weather_change_rate: Frequency of meteorological transitions between clear, rain, fog, and storm (0.002).
godHints.weather_sickness_enabled: Enables exposure chill and hypothermia when caught unsheltered in wet or freezing weather.
godHints.chill_drain: Direct health drain per tick when chilled outdoors without shelter (0.18).
godHints.shelter_enabled: Master switch for house claiming, door navigation, and roof protection.
godHints.territory_enabled: Enables clan boundary markings, territory defence, and trespass penalties.
godHints.max_clans: Maximum number of sovereign clans spawned during world initialization (-1 = auto).
godHints.totems_enabled: Enables Sacred Avatar totem blessings for each clan settlement.
godHints.succession_enabled: Enables dynamic governance leadership transfers on chieftain death.
godHints.communication_enabled: Enables vocalizations, alarm chirps, peace hums, and emotional thought bubbles.
godHints.knowledge_enabled: Enables spatial memory, waypoint mapping, and rumor broadcasting among kin.
godHints.schism_enabled: Enables internal clan fractures when members starve or lack shelter.
godHints.war_enabled: Enables inter-clan warfare, tactical raids, and territorial conquest.
godHints.attack_damage: Base damage dealt by soldiers and warriors in inter-clan battles (32.0).
godHints.predation_enabled: Enables carnivorous predator-prey ecology and hunting dynamics.
godHints.predator_ratio: Fraction of population spawned as predatory carnivores hunting prey (0.02).
godHints.hunt_radius: Aggro detection radius within which carnivores and war parties acquire targets (16.0).
godHints.bite_damage: Combat damage dealt per carnivore attack or predatory strike (28.0).
godHints.energy_from_prey: Caloric energy extracted from slaying and eating a prey creature (45.0).
godHints.fear_radius: Distance at which herbivores and vulnerable castes detect threats and execute evasion (12.0).
godHints.coalitions_enabled: Enables mutual defensive alliances and diplomatic treaties between friendly clans.
godHints.leader_decisions_enabled: Enables chieftain governance bylaws (rationing, martial law, war declarations).
godHints.resource_sharing_enabled: Enables communal settlement larders and altruistic basket food sharing.
godHints.cannibalism_enabled: Enables desperate consumption of the living during extreme starvation.
godHints.eat_kin_enabled: Allows consumption of deceased or weak clanmates at the cost of tribal exile and feuds.
godHints.cannibalism_energy: Energy gained by starving creatures resorting to eating fallen kin or rivals (45.0).
godHints.theology_enabled: Enables the 8 Sacred Avatars, shrines, temples, miracles, and divine tithes.
godHints.tithe_rate: Fraction of energy devout worshippers offer at shrines each dawn & dusk to build clan faith (0.04).
godHints.temple_faith_cost: Faith points required to consecrate a glowing Temple of the Sphere (400.0).
godHints.age_enabled: Enables historical epoch progression (Golden Age, Ice Age, Age of Chaos, Age of Plague).
godHints.culture_enabled: Enables traditions, governance archetypes, and cultural diffusion.
godHints.rivers_enabled: Enables water channels, fords, water currents, bridges, and dams.
godHints.relief_enabled: Enables topographical elevation, slope inertia, cliffs, and road packing.
godHints.structural_enabled: Enables weather wear on buildings, builder repairs, and roof collapse into rubble.
godHints.earthquake_enabled: Enables seismic tremors that shake terrain and damage weakened structures.
godHints.lightning_enabled: Enables real lightning strikes during storms that ignite fires and damage creatures.
godHints.wildfire_enabled: Enables combustive flame propagation across dense vegetation and forests.
godHints.disaster_enabled: Enables cataclysmic meteors, floods, and natural world disturbances.

godToggles.birth_enabledHint: whether new life may begin at all — off hides the lineage dials
godToggles.morphology_annealing_enabledHint: master switch for geometric physics — off keeps classic sides, on enables polar (r,φ) annealing
godToggles.safeguard_enabledHint: homeostatic negative feedback loops (eta) and Sphere Genesis miracles below critical population floor
godToggles.safeguard_morph_mercyHint: suspends irregular infant euthanasia during low-population relief states (eta > 0.30)
godToggles.soft_cap_enabledHint: non-linear homeostatic damping (xi) scaling birth rates and metabolic drain when exceeding carrying capacity
godToggles.disease_enabledHint: plagues walk the world; disabling freezes all sickness
godToggles.weather_enabledHint: whether the weather ever turns — off hides rain/fog/storm dials everywhere
godToggles.sleep_enabledHint: creatures shelter in houses after dark
godToggles.shelter_enabledHint: creatures may claim roofs; disabling leaves all exposed and hides the shelter dials
godToggles.hearths_enabledHint: kin buy hearth fuel from the larder — a lit hearth warms the roof through winter; unfed, it goes dark
godToggles.territory_enabledHint: clans claim a circle around their house; disabling removes borders
godToggles.weather_sickness_enabledHint: chill and wet contagion — rain/storm/winter nights build chill, past threshold drains health; wet catches disease faster
godToggles.communication_enabledHint: food + alarm calls — clan-mates respond strongly, strangers weakly; rendered as ripples
godToggles.knowledge_enabledHint: creatures learn facts from experience (food/danger/enemies/safe homes), share them as rumors at half confidence; the clan remembers
godToggles.help_call_enabledHint: an attacked creature calls its clan; warriors rally first and mob the attacker, defenders soften its blows
godToggles.wildfire_enabledHint: fire ignites via storm lightning / fire_rate and spreads grass→plant→house; ash fertilizes
godToggles.disaster_enabledHint: meteor/flood stochastic — god sets frequency, never a specific strike
godToggles.rivers_enabledHint: horizontal channels: fords cost energy, the current sweeps infants and the wounded, rain floods the banks and leaves silt; builders span planks and raise dams
godToggles.relief_enabledHint: the land has height: uphill burns energy, cliffs deal fall damage, rain slides steep slopes, feet pack fast roads that grow nothing
godToggles.earthquake_enabledHint: rare quakes throw bodies, drop weakened roofs and crack stone; Pentagons+ feel the deep hum three ticks early
godToggles.lightning_enabledHint: bolts kill under the arc, ignite the ground and fuse electrostatic rock
godToggles.structural_enabledHint: storms & floodwater wear buildings down; builders mend what still stands; a spent roof collapses to ruin
godToggles.rubble_blocking_enabledHint: collapsed ruins leave rubble that bars the ground until builders clear it
godToggles.culture_enabledHint: culture spreads to allied neighbours, can split into rival traditions; grants small collective bonus
godToggles.age_enabledHint: super-seasons: Golden/Ice/Chaos/Plague — each bends food/mutation/disease/chill. God sets length, world cycles
godToggles.schism_enabledHint: unhappy members (starving/homeless) split off to found new clan then war parent — schism_threshold fraction to trigger
godToggles.totems_enabledHint: each clan bears one of the 8 Sacred Avatars of the Sphere (⭕ ⚡ 👁️ 🛡️ 🌿 ⚖️ 🌀 🕯️) granting a distinct divine blessing; disabling makes all clans plain
godToggles.succession_enabledHint: leader succession on death emits succession event; disabling keeps founder as eternal leader
godToggles.plant_variants_enabledHint: grass/berry/mushroom/poisonous diversity; disabling makes all plants grass
godToggles.predation_enabledHint: predators hunt prey; disabling makes them docile
godToggles.war_enabledHint: rival clans fight on contact; disabling enforces peace
godToggles.coalitions_enabledHint: allied clans form defensive blocs — strike one member and every mate turns on you; soured relations dissolve the pact
godToggles.leader_decisions_enabledHint: leaders declare war on remembered enemies, sue for peace when weakened, demand tribute, betray allies (bold→war, peaceful→peace, paranoid→betrayal)
godToggles.resource_sharing_enabledHint: a food store at the settlement: well-fed members deposit surplus, starving members withdraw; allies aid each other in famine
godToggles.tribute_enabledHint: weak clans pay periodic tribute from their larder to a stronger protector
godToggles.betrayal_enabledHint: a leader breaks an alliance and strikes — the betrayed clan's rivals are told the same tale (treason)
godToggles.defection_enabledHint: unhappy members (starving/homeless) walk to a healthier nearby banner, even a rival's
godToggles.cannibalism_enabledHint: the starving may hunt and eat living creatures — sated/hungry never do; cooldown between kills
godToggles.eat_enemy_enabledHint: enemy-clan members (negative relation) and the weak (starving/elder/wounded) of any clan are legitimate prey; never predators, infants or indoor refugees
godToggles.eat_kin_enabledHint: weak kin may be eaten too — at a terrible price: exile, stigma, and a clan that now counts you an enemy
godToggles.exile_on_kin_eatHint: the kin-eater is cast out and founds a one-being outcast band; disabling keeps them in the clan but shunned
godToggles.food_decay_enabledHint: mature plants wither after their lifespan (× variant pace), fertilise nearby soil, then vanish — nothing lasts forever
godToggles.theology_enabledHint: shrines beside main houses, dawn & dusk tithes fill the clan faith pool, the aura mends the faithful, seasonal miracles, law-change chimes & sermons, holy synods in crisis ages, temples at high faith
godToggles.agriculture_enabledHint: seed pouches from wild harvests, cultivated farm plots near the settlement (2× growth, 2.5× yield), weeding & tending, irrigation furrows by fertile groves
godToggles.granaries_enabledHint: a dry roofed store: sated harvesters lay grain & cured berries by (35%), starving members withdraw, feasts burn it
godToggles.soil_depletion_enabledHint: monocropping exhausts the soil grid and slows regrowth; corpses, withered plants and farmer compost restore it
godToggles.banquets_enabledHint: granary ≥80% feeds a feast: energy, cheer, warmer relations and +30% fertility while it lasts
godToggles.vocalizations_enabledHint: priest liturgy calms panic, women's peace-hum parts crowds, soldiers' war-chirps rally allies, artisan chimes gift basket food, touching vertices builds trust
godToggles.scent_enabledHint: foragers drop breadcrumb trails home from rich finds; violent deaths and ruins leave danger scent the young learn to avoid
godToggles.envoys_enabledHint: peaceful leaders send banner-carrying emissaries to rival houses; clans raise boundary stones that ring warning chimes at trespassers
godToggles.markets_enabledHint: allied neighbours found neutral trading posts at shared borders and barter surplus; peddler caravans carry goods and news between distant settlements
godToggles.omens_enabledHint: at each season turn a shrine priest proclaims what comes; worshippers who hear it head home prepared
godToggles.dialect_drift_enabledHint: isolated clans drift apart in speech; strangers understand each other less the further dialects split, allies converge on a shared tongue
godToggles.cosmologyNote: Hidden zones of altered physics — fertile ground, heavy gravity, calm air. Skilled foragers discover them; shrines beside one draw extra power. Law changes sweep a shimmer wave across the land.
godToggles.worshipNote: the Sacred Avatars of the Sphere: settled clans consecrate shrines, the devout tithe at dawn & dusk, faith works miracles, chimes ring when laws change, and high faith raises temples
godToggles.edgeHint: what happens at the edge of the world

society.war_hint: Aggregate likelihood of border raids or inter-clan war breaking out.
society.trade_markets_hint: Neutral trading hubs established at mutual borders between allied or trade-partner clans.
society.caravan_routes_hint: Active merchant supply lines transporting grain, goods, and cultural news between settlements.

crisis.ext_danger_desc: • Extinction Danger: Effective breeding population (Ne={{ne}}) is below safe viability threshold ({{females}}♀ / {{males}}♂).
crisis.starve_threat_desc: • Starvation Threat: Famine horizon is {{horizon}} ticks — granaries are depleting faster than plant regrowth.
crisis.schism_threat_desc: • Schism & Revolt: Internal unrest score is {{score}} — clan splintering or desertion is imminent.

mutation_lab.title: Morphological Annealing & Mutation Lab
mutation_lab.annealing_hint: How much creatures blend rigid Abbott caste templates (λ=1.0) with noisy mutated genes (λ=0.0) as generations progress.
mutation_lab.mutation_freq_hint: Percentage of active living creatures bearing altered side counts or structural irregularity.
mutation_lab.irregularity_hint: Geometric asymmetry score (0.0 = regular polygon, >0.3 = visibly distorted mutant body).
mutation_lab.max_gen_hint: Highest generational depth reached through continuous breeding and lineage survival.
mutation_lab.abbott_hint: Distribution of polygon vertices across castes. Mutations occasionally produce novel non-canonical geometries.
mutation_lab.top_mutants_hint: Living creatures in the simulation exhibiting the highest physical irregularity.
mutation_lab.recent_feed_hint: Real-time log of creatures born with morphological aberrations or genetic side jumps.
mutation_lab.no_mutations_yet: No mutant births recorded yet in this era.

hints.pop: Total living population currently simulated in the world.
hints.biomass: Aggregate vitality of all creatures (total health + energy).
hints.energy_sat: Mean metabolic reserve ratio across the population (Energy / Max Energy).
hints.birth_vel: Births per minute across all clans.
hints.death_vel: Mortality events per minute across all causes.
hints.mortality_dist: Decomposition of recent death causes over a 500-tick rolling window.
hints.predator: Count of carnivorous predators hunting prey.
hints.plant_biomass: Total ripe and growing wild & cultivated plants on the map.
hints.shannon: Shannon-Wiener Biodiversity Index (0..2.0). Higher entropy indicates healthy flora variety against crop disease.
hints.evenness: Species distribution uniformity (0..1.0). High evenness prevents monoculture collapse.
hints.richness: Number of distinct plant species actively growing.
hints.corpse_recycle: Ratio of deceased organic matter returned to the living ecosystem.
hints.hhi: Herfindahl-Hirschman Clan Hegemony Index (0..1.0). Measures territorial and demographic monopoly by dominant clans.
hints.larder_gini: Larder Inequality Gini Coefficient (0..1.0). 0 is perfectly egalitarian; >0.5 indicates severe resource hoarding.
hints.basket_gini: Individual Foraging Inequality (0..1.0) measuring disparity in personal food baskets.
hints.famine_horizon: Estimated ticks until famine strikes based on net metabolic burn vs granary stores.
hints.extinction_ne: Effective Population Size (Ne). Harmonic breeding viability metric. Values < 10 warn of genetic bottleneck / extinction risk.
hints.unrest: Internal clan friction based on overcrowded shelters, hunger stress, and personality discord.
hints.schism_risk: Warning threshold indicating risk of clan rebellion, desertion, or civil fragmentation.

mutationLab.clustersHint: Clusters: low-A sharp apex vs high-A bulky armor
mutationLab.phylogenyHint: Lines = documented parentage when available; size encodes irregularity. Faint icons = Abbott orthodoxy (regular 3/4/5/8/24).
